description: Frederik Hendrikbuurt 1885-90 gable pands (Houweningenstraat 31, Frederik Hendrikstraat 154 and 134): the dentil-pediment body with round-arched upper windows under stone arch rings with keystones, and a pointed brick gable with one attic light over the cornice instead of a dormer; paired red doors under a round-headed ground arch are not drawn.

match.note: houweningen-1-31, houweningen-2-38, reigersbergen-1-37, hendrik-134-154 strips (2021-2022); 3DBAG eaves 13.5-14.0 m

point-gable.note: pointed brick gable with one attic light, no white cornice (the neighbours cornice stops at the gable pand); strips houweningen-1-31 2021-02-22 (pands 15/31 at px 1704-1892 and 3208-3396), hendrik-134-154 2022-04-29: apex 17.1 m over the ground against 3DBAG eaves 13.7 m, 3.4 m = 1.15 upper storeys of 2.95 m (was 1.5 = 4.4 m, drawn about 1 m too tall)

roof.evidence: strips 2021-03/2022-04: over the cornice only the dormers and gables stand against the sky; dark slate band behind (hendrik-134-154)

rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: pair of doors + wide window | 1: 3 | 2: 3 | 3: 3
rhythm.roofline: white cornice, centre pediment dormer, occasional pointed gable
rhythm.citation: strips houweningen-1-31 2021-02-22, hendrik-134-154 2022-04-29; iron wall anchors on every pier read on houweningen-1-31 15 and 31; arch rings on storeys 1-3 (the top storey passes the audit once the gable crown has no cornice)
rhythm.signage: none above the ground; per-door numbers
rhythm.identicalBays: upper storeys: equal axes, no balconies
